card.name: Syllables in romanized Chinese names
card.fires_on: The last syllable of a pinyin-romanized Chinese name or herbal formula, such as ang or tang, when it comes right before a name ends or a bracket closes.

modes.label: Herbal formula names
modes.description: The closing syllable tang or ang of a pinyin herbal formula name in brackets, followed by a use for headache or pain.
